name: WH - WF4 Social Carousel Render & Publish

parameters.jsCode:
const p = $input.first().json;
const s = p.story || {};
const totalSlides = Math.max(4, Math.min(7, (p.assets && p.assets.length) || 6));
const slideSubjects = (p.assets || []).map(a => `Slide ${a["Slide Index"]}: ${a.Name || "Visual"}${a["AI Generated"] ? " [AI ILLUSTRATION]" : ""}`).join("\n");
const prompt = [
  "You are the lead social editor for WE, HUMANITY, turning a researched story into a high-retention " + totalSlides + "-slide Instagram/LinkedIn carousel.",
  "",
  "Story Title: " + (s.Title || ""),
  "Pillar: " + (s.Pillar || ""),
  "Glance: " + (s.Glance || ""),
  "Explore: " + (s.Explore || ""),
  "Deep Dive: " + (s["Deep Dive"] || ""),
  "Remember: " + (s.Remember || ""),
  "",
  "Planned slide visuals:",
  slideSubjects || ("1 to " + totalSlides),
  "",
  "CRITICAL EDITORIAL RULES:",
  "1. STRICTER ACCURACY & HEDGING: Only state facts present in the source story above—never invent dramatic claims (e.g. a single error throwing a city into disarray). Always include the key spine facts (century/date, discovery year, and geographic location) when present in the source. Distinguish physical evidence from scholarly reconstruction using hedges like \"researchers believe\" or \"likely\". Hedge historical uniqueness (e.g. \"no comparable geared devices are known for about a thousand years\" instead of \"unmatched for a thousand years\"). Use precise technical terms (e.g. \"X-ray CT scans\" with the team/decade). If a slide's visual is a modern replica/model, note that it is a modern replica in the text.",
  "2. SENTENCE CASE HEADLINES: Write ALL headlines in modern Instagram Sentence case (only the first word and proper nouns capitalized), NEVER Title Case.",
  "3. SLIDE 1 (COVER) MUST BE A PUNCHY CLAIM: Write a short, surprising claim headline (7 to 12 words) that states the payoff (e.g. \"A 2,000-year-old lump from a shipwreck was a computer.\"), not a dry title or label. Write a crisp 1-sentence subtitle (10 to 16 words) with NO parentheses.",
  "4. CONSTRAINT-TO-TAKEAWAY ARC (SLIDES 2-" + totalSlides + "): Structure the middle slides as a clear narrative spine: the hard constraint (and discovery/origin when/where), what inspection or craft revealed, how the exact mechanism or interface decision works, and why that principle still matters today. Every headline (4 to 10 words) must deliver a clear insight in Sentence case—never use structural labels like \"The Hook\", \"The Problem\", or \"The Legacy\".",
  "5. PLAIN LANGUAGE & 28-35 WORDS PER SLIDE: Use plain everyday words instead of academic jargon. Body text MUST be 28 to 35 words per slide (22 to 30 words on the final slide " + totalSlides + ") in 1-2 short, complete sentences, one idea per slide. Never end mid-sentence or with ellipses.",
  "6. STRICT HIGHLIGHTING (MAX 3 WORDS): Wrap at most 1 to 3 key words (one short phrase) per slide in **double asterisks**. Put the highlight in EITHER the headline OR the body, never both, and NEVER highlight the CTA.",
  "7. SINGLE-QUESTION CTA ON FINAL SLIDE: Set \"cta\" to ONE short question only (4 to 6 words, e.g. \"Which ancient innovation next?\" or \"Which interface classic next?\"). Do NOT combine with \"Save this\" or put ** in \"cta\".",
  "8. CAPTIONS: Write \"instagram_caption\" with a keyword-rich first-line hook, 2 short plain-language paragraphs, a short question CTA, and 3 to 5 relevant hashtags at the end. Write \"linkedin_caption\" with a keyword-rich first line and crisp summary.",
  "",
  "Return ONLY valid JSON:",
  "{",
  "  \"slides\": [",
  "    { \"slide_index\": 1, \"headline\": \"...\", \"body\": \"...\" },",
  "    ... exact length " + totalSlides + " (indices 1.." + totalSlides + ")",
  "  ],",
  "  \"cta\": \"...\",",
  "  \"instagram_caption\": \"...\",",
  "  \"linkedin_caption\": \"...\",",
  "  \"x_post_1\": \"...\",",
  "  \"x_post_2\": \"...\"",
  "}"
].join("\n");
return [{ json: { ...p, copyPrompt: prompt } }];
